<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">主流开源大模型架构对比报告</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">一、主流开源大模型</span> <span style="font-family: 等线">对比</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">目前开源大模型，比较经典的有：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">国外：</span>LLaMA<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">BLOOM</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Falcon</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Mixtral</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">T5</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">国内：</span>Qwen<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">DeepSeek</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">ChatGLM</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span></p>

<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">二、大模型架构</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>LLaMA(Large Language Model Meta AI)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">研发机构</span>:</strong>&nbsp;Meta AI</li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">架构</span>:</strong>&nbsp;LLaMA <span style="font-family: 等线">系列模型采用了经典的 </span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">仅解码器（</span>Decoder-only<span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></strong><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">的</span> Transformer <span style="font-family: 等线">架构</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span>Llama 3.1<span style="font-family: 等线">架构是经过高度优化的实现，包含了当前业界公认的高性能组件</span><span style="font-family: 等线">：（</span> RMSNorm + SwiGLU + RoPE + GQA<span style="font-family: 等线">）</span></li>
</ul>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">归一化</span> </strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：采用前置归一化（</span>Pre-normalization<span style="font-family: 等线">）并使用</span><span style="font-family: Arial">RMSNorm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">来保证训练过程的稳定性。 &nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">激活函数</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：使用</span>SwiGLU<span style="font-family: 等线">激活函数，相较于标准的</span><span style="font-family: Arial">ReLU</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，它能提供更好的性能表现。 &nbsp;</span></p>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">位置编码</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：采用旋转位置编码（</span>Rotary Positional Embeddings, RoPE<span style="font-family: 等线">）来为序列中的</span><span style="font-family: Arial">token</span><span style="font-family: 等线">注入位置信息。 </span></p>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">注意力机制</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在所有尺寸的模型（</span>8B<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">70B</span><span style="font-family: 等线">和</span><span style="font-family: Arial">405B</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）中均采用了分组查询注意力（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Grouped-Query Attention, GQA</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GQA</span><span style="font-family: 等线">通过让多组查询头（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query heads</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）共享同一份键（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）和值（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）头，显著减少了推理过程中键值缓存（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV cache</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）的内存占用，这是实现模型可扩展性，尤其是在处理长序列时的一项关键优化。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">相关论文</span>:</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong>LLaMA:</strong>&nbsp;<em>“LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models”https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.13971</em></p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095613495-1783831313.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 等线">图</span> LLaMA-3 <span style="font-family: 等线">模型结构</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">三、细节结构解释</span></strong></p>
<p>1. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心结构</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>Decoder-only (<span style="font-family: 等线">解码器架构</span><span style="font-family: Arial">)</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：这是当前主流生成式</span> LLM <span style="font-family: 等线">的选择，包括 </span><strong>LLaMA<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">BLOOM</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Falcon</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Qwen</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Kimi</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。这种架构非常适合自回归的文本生成任务，如对话、写作、问答等。模型根据已经生成的文本，预测下一个词。</span></p>
<p><strong>Encoder-Decoder (<span style="font-family: 等线">编码器</span><span style="font-family: Arial">-</span><span style="font-family: 等线">解码器架构</span><span style="font-family: Arial">)</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><strong>T5</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是该架构的典型代表。它拥有一个完整的编码器来理解输入文本（源序列），和一个解码器来生成输出文本（目标序列）。这种结构天然适用于</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">序列到序列</span> (Seq2Seq)</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">任务，如机器翻译、文本摘要、问题生成等。</span></p>
<p><strong>MoE (Mixture-of-Experts / <span style="font-family: 等线">专家混合架构</span><span style="font-family: Arial">)</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><strong>Mixtral<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">DeepSeek</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、悟道</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">采用了这种高效扩展架构。其核心思想是，</span><span style="font-family: 等线">模型包含大量</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">专家</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（即前馈网络），但在处理每个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">时，只通过一个</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">路由器</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">动态选择激活一小部分专家。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优势</span></strong>: <span style="font-family: 等线">可以在保持计算量（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">FLOPs</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）相对稳定的情况下，将模型总参数量扩展到极大（万亿级别），从而增强模型的容量和知识储备。这是实现</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">大而快</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">的关键。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>GLM (General Language Model / <span style="font-family: 等线">通用语言模型</span><span style="font-family: Arial">)</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><strong>ChatGLM</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">采用的独特架构。它通过自回归填空的目标进行预训练，并采用</span><span style="font-family: 等线">特殊的注意力掩码</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，使其能够同时处理双向和单向的上下文信息。这使得它在理解（</span>NLU<span style="font-family: 等线">）和生成（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">NLG</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）任务上都有较好的表现。</span></p>
<p><strong>Transformer</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">目前大模型的基本架构是基于</span>Transformer<span style="font-family: 等线">的。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095625197-931030975.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 等线">图</span> transformer<span style="font-family: 等线">架构</span></p>
<p><strong>MoE <span style="font-family: 等线">专家混合模型</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>MoE <span style="font-family: 等线">并不是一个特定的模型，而是一种</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">架构范式</span> (Architectural Paradigm)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。它的核心思想是通过</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">条件计算</span> (Conditional Computation)</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">来扩大模型规模，而不是简单地增加模型密度。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">想象一下，你不需要在解决每个问题时都动用整个大脑，而是根据问题的类型，只激活大脑中特定领域的专家区域。这就是</span> MoE <span style="font-family: 等线">的直觉。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">稀疏激活</span> (Sparse Activation)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在一个稠密模型（</span>Dense Model<span style="font-family: 等线">）中，对于任何输入，所有参数都会被激活和使用。而在 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MoE </span><span style="font-family: 等线">模型中，输入 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">只会被路由到一小部分</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">专家</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Experts</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）那里进行处理。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">专家网络</span> (Experts)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：每个专家通常是一个独立的前馈神经网络</span> (FFN)<span style="font-family: 等线">。一个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MoE </span><span style="font-family: 等线">层包含多个这样的专家。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">门控网络</span>/<span style="font-family: 等线">路由器 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">(Gating Network / Router)</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：这是一个小型的神经网络，它的作用是</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">决策者</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。它接收输入的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，然后决定应该将这个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">发送给哪些专家处理。它会为每个专家生成一个权重，通常只选择权重最高的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Top-k </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个专家（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">k </span><span style="font-family: 等线">通常是 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">1 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">或 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">2</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">组合输出</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：各个被激活的专家的输出会根据门控网络给出的权重进行加权求和，形成最终的输出。</span></li>
</ol>
<p><strong>MoE <span style="font-family: 等线">的优势</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">巨大的参数规模</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：可以在不显著增加计算成本（</span>FLOPs<span style="font-family: 等线">）的情况下，将模型的总参数量扩展到数万亿级别。因为每次前向传播只使用了总参数的一小部分。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">训练和推理更快</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对于给定的参数总量，</span>MoE <span style="font-family: 等线">模型的计算量远小于同等规模的稠密模型。例如，一个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">1.8T </span><span style="font-family: 等线">参数的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MoE </span><span style="font-family: 等线">模型（如 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Mixtral 8x7B</span><span style="font-family: 等线">），其每次前向传播的计算量只相当于一个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">14B </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的稠密模型（因为每个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">只激活 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">2 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">7B </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的专家）。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">专业化</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：不同的专家可以在训练过程中学会处理不同类型的数据或模式，实现某种程度的专业化。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>MoE <span style="font-family: 等线">的挑战</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">训练不稳定</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：门控网络的决策可能导致负载不均衡（某些专家被过度使用，某些专家几乎不用），需要引入额外的损失函数（如</span> Load Balancing Loss<span style="font-family: 等线">）来鼓励均匀分配。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">通信开销大</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在分布式训练中，不同专家可能位于不同的</span> GPU <span style="font-family: 等线">上，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">在专家之间的路由会引入显著的通信延迟。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">推理复杂</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：需要更多的</span> VRAM <span style="font-family: 等线">来容纳所有专家参数，即使每次只使用一小部分。这使得模型部署变得困难。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095639049-1666718104.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>GLM</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">参考资料</span> :<span style="font-family: 等线">复制的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">DataWhale happyllm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">项目 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">chapter3 </span></strong>https://github.com/datawhalechina/happy-llm/blob/main/docs/chapter3/%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%89%E7%AB%A0%20%E9%A2%84%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E8%AF%AD%E8%A8%80%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B.md#333-glm</p>
<p>GLM <span style="font-family: 等线">最初是由清华计算机系推出的一种通用语言模型基座，其核心思路是在传统 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">预训练任务基础上，加入 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">思想，从而构建一个在 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">NLG </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">NLU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">任务上都具有良好表现的统一模型。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在整体模型结构上，</span>GLM <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GPT </span><span style="font-family: 等线">大致类似，均是 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Decoder-Only </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的结构，仅有三点细微差异：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">使用</span> Post Norm <span style="font-family: 等线">而非 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Pre Norm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Post Norm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是指在进行残差连接计算时，先完成残差计算，再进行 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">计算；而类似于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GPT</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">LLaMA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">等模型都使用了 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Pre Norm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，也就是先进行 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">计算，再进行残差的计算。相对而言，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Post Norm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">由于在残差之后做归一化，对参数正则化的效果更强，进而模型的鲁棒性也会更好；</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Pre Norm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">相对于因为有一部分参数直接加在了后面，不需要对这部分参数进行正则化，正好可以防止模型的梯度爆炸或者梯度消失。因此，对于更大体量的模型来说，一般认为 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Pre Norm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">效果会更好。但 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">论文提出，使用 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Post Norm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">可以避免 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的数值错误（虽然主流 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">仍然使用了 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Pre Norm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）；</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">使用单个线性层实现最终</span> token <span style="font-family: 等线">的预测，而不是使用 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLP</span><span style="font-family: 等线">；这样的结构更加简单也更加鲁棒，即减少了最终输出的参数量，将更大的参数量放在了模型本身；</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">激活函数从</span> ReLU <span style="font-family: 等线">换成了 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GeLUs</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span><span style="font-family: Arial">ReLU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是传统的激活函数，其核心计算逻辑为去除小于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">0</span><span style="font-family: 等线">的传播，保留大于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">0</span><span style="font-family: 等线">的传播；</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GeLUs </span><span style="font-family: 等线">核心是对接近于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">0</span><span style="font-family: 等线">的正向传播，做了一个非线性映射，保证了激活函数后的非线性输出，具有一定的连续性。</span></li>
</ol>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span>2<span style="font-family: 等线">）预训练任务</span><span style="font-family: Arial">-GLM</span></strong></p>
<p>GLM <span style="font-family: 等线">的核心创新点主要在于其提出的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GLM</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">General Language Model</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，通用语言模型）任务，这也是 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的名字由来。</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是一种结合了自编码思想和自回归思想的预训练方法。所谓自编码思想，其实也就是 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的任务学习思路，在输入文本中随机删除连续的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">tokens</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，要求模型学习被删除的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">tokens</span><span style="font-family: 等线">；所谓自回归思想，其实就是传统的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">任务学习思路，也就是要求模型按顺序重建连续 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">tokens</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p>GLM <span style="font-family: 等线">通过优化一个自回归空白填充任务来实现 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">思想的结合。其核心思想是，对于一个输入序列，会类似于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">一样进行随机的掩码，但遮蔽的不是和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">一样的单个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，而是每次遮蔽一连串 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token</span><span style="font-family: 等线">；模型在学习时，既需要使用遮蔽部分的上下文预测遮蔽部分，在遮蔽部分内部又需要以 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的方式完成被遮蔽的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">tokens </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的预测。例如，输入和输出可能是：</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Plain Text<br><span style="font-family: Consolas">输入：</span>I &lt;MASK&gt; because you &lt;MASK&gt;<br><span style="font-family: Consolas">输出：</span>&lt;MASK&gt; - love you; &lt;MASK&gt; - are a wonderful person</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">通过将</span> MLM <span style="font-family: 等线">与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">思想相结合，既适配逐个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">生成的生成类任务，也迫使模型从前后两个方向学习输入文本的隐含关系从而适配了理解类任务。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">不过，</span>GLM <span style="font-family: 等线">预训练任务更多的优势还是展现在预训练模型时代，迈入 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">时代后，针对于超大规模、体量的预训练，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">展现出远超 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的优势。通过将模型体量加大、预训练规模扩大，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">预训练得到的生成模型在文本理解上也能具有超出 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">训练的理解模型的能力，因此，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">ChatGLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">系列模型也仅在第一代模型使用了 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的预训练思想，从 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">ChatGLM2 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">开始，还是回归了传统的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">建模。虽然从 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的整体发展路径来看，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">预训练任务似乎是一个失败的尝试，但通过精巧的设计将 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MLM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">融合，并第一时间产出了中文开源的原生 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LLM</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，其思路仍然存在较大的借鉴意义。</span></p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095818594-1759521676.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095824770-442276024.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">归一化层</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>LayerNorm</strong>: <span style="font-family: 等线">经典归一化层，</span><strong>BLOOM<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">T5</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">使用。</span></p>
<p><strong>RMSNorm</strong>: <strong>LLaMA<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Falcon</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Mixtral</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Qwen</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">DeepSeek</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">等现代模型的标配。它简化了</span> LayerNorm<span style="font-family: 等线">，移除了均值中心化步骤，计算更快。</span></p>
<p><strong>DeepNorm</strong>: <strong>ChatGLM</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">使用的一种更复杂的归一化技术，旨在让极深层网络的训练更加稳定。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">位置</span></strong>: <span style="font-family: 等线">所有现代模型都采用了</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">预归一化</span> (Pre-Normalization)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，即在每个子模块（注意力和</span>FFN<span style="font-family: 等线">）的输入端进行归一化，这已成为稳定训练的标准实践。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095832495-494103354.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">如何选择？</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>LayerNorm</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：是一个非常安全和稳健的选择，适用于绝大多数</span> Transformer <span style="font-family: 等线">和其他需要样本内归一化的场景。</span></p>
<p><strong>RMSNorm</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：如果你追求极致的训练和推理速度，并且实验证明在你的任务上性能与</span> LayerNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">无异，那么 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">RMSNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是一个绝佳的替代品。现代很多大模型（如 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Llama </span><span style="font-family: 等线">系列）已经默认使用 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">RMSNorm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p><strong>DeepNorm</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：只有当你需要训练非常非常深（例如几百上千层）的模型时才需要考虑。对于常规深度（例如</span> 12-48 <span style="font-family: 等线">层）的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Transformer</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，标准的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Post-LN </span><span style="font-family: 等线">或 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Pre-LN </span><span style="font-family: 等线">结构通常已经足够稳定。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>LayerNorm</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">对单个样本（或</span> token<span style="font-family: 等线">）的所有特征进行归一化</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p>LayerNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">是为了解决 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Batch Normalization (BN) </span><span style="font-family: 等线">在循环神经网络 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">(RNN) </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和小批量 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">(small batch size) </span><span style="font-family: 等线">场景下的不足而提出的。与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">BN </span><span style="font-family: 等线">在批次维度上进行归一化不同，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">在单个样本的特征维度上进行归一化。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">对于每一个样本，独立地计算其所有特征的均值和方差，然后用这些统计量来归一化该样本的特征。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">这种方式有两个主要优点：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">独立于批次大小</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：每个样本独立计算，即使批次大小为</span> 1 <span style="font-family: 等线">也能正常工作。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">适用于序列数据</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对于变长的序列数据（如文本），可以在每个时间步上对特征向量进行归一化，非常方便。</span></li>


</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095847780-1682964678.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br><br>class LayerNorm(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, normalized_shape, eps=1e-5):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 如果 normalized_shape 是整数，则将其转换为元组<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if isinstance(normalized_shape, int):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;normalized_shape = (normalized_shape,)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.normalized_shape = normalized_shape<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.eps = eps<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 可学习的增益 gamma 和偏置 beta<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.gamma = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(self.normalized_shape))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.beta = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.normalized_shape))<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算需要归一化的维度的均值和方差<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# keepdim=True 保持维度以便进行广播计算<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;mean = x.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;var = x.var(dim=-1, unbiased=False, keepdim=True)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 归一化<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x_normalized = (x - mean) / torch.sqrt(var + self.eps)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 缩放和平移<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = self.gamma * x_normalized + self.beta<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return output<br><br># 使用示例<br># 假设我们有一个批次为 4，序列长度为 10，特征维度为 20 的张量<br>x = torch.randn(4, 10, 20)<br>ln = LayerNorm(normalized_shape=20)<br>output = ln(x)<br>print("自定义 LayerNorm 输出尺寸:", output.shape)<br><br># 对比 PyTorch 内置的 LayerNorm<br>pytorch_ln = nn.LayerNorm(normalized_shape=20)<br>pytorch_output = pytorch_ln(x)<br>print("PyTorch LayerNorm 输出尺寸:", pytorch_output.shape)</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RMSNorm</strong></p>
<p>RMSNorm (Root Mean Square Layer Normalization) <span style="font-family: 等线">是对 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的一种简化，旨在减少计算开销。研究者发现，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">中的均值中心化（减去均值 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">μ</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）对性能的贡献不大，但却占用了相当一部分计算量。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">移除均值中心化步骤，只通过均方根</span> (Root Mean Square) <span style="font-family: 等线">来对神经元的激活值进行缩放。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">这种简化的主要优点是：</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">计算效率更高</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在</span> GPU <span style="font-family: 等线">上，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">RMSNorm</span><span style="font-family: 等线">比 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">快 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">7% </span><span style="font-family: 等线">到 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">64% </span><span style="font-family: 等线">不等。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">性能相当</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在多种任务上，</span>RMSNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">的性能与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">相当。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095908855-433206604.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225095916105-1973638169.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>g<span style="font-family: 等线">是可学习参数</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br><br>class RMSNorm(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, dim, eps=1e-6):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.eps = eps<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 增益参数 gamma<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.gamma = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim))<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def _norm(self, x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算输入的均方根<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# rsqrt 是平方根倒数的快速计算<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 归一化并应用增益<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return self._norm(x) * self.gamma<br><br># 使用示例<br># 假设我们有一个批次为 4，序列长度为 10，特征维度为 20 的张量<br>x = torch.randn(4, 10, 20)<br>rms_norm = RMSNorm(dim=20)<br>output = rms_norm(x)<br>print("RMSNorm 输出尺寸:", output.shape)</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优势</span></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">更快的计算</span>,RMSNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">只计算平方和，计算量减少：</span></strong></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">数值稳定性</span></strong></li>


</ol>
<p>LayerNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">计算 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">μ </span><span style="font-family: 等线">时可能出现小数精度问题，而 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">RMSNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">不涉及均值计算，数值更稳定。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">避免均值归一化导致的梯度消失问题。</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">适用于</span> Transformer</strong></li>


</ol>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span> GPT<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Llama</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Gemma </span><span style="font-family: 等线">这类 </span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">超大规模</span> Transformer <span style="font-family: 等线">语言模型</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中，</span>RMSNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">的高效计算可以显著减少训练时间。</span></p>
<p>Google DeepMind <span style="font-family: 等线">研究表明，</span><strong>RMSNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">可以替代 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">而不损失性能</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，特别是在</span> <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">低精度训练</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span>FP16, BF16<span style="font-family: 等线">） 场景下。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>DeepNorm</strong></p>
<p>DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">并不是像 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">或 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">RMSNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">那样的一种具体的</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">归一化层</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，而是一种</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">用于稳定极深</span> Transformer <span style="font-family: 等线">模型训练的理论和方法</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。它通过结合特定的</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">权重初始化</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">和对</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">残差连接的理论分析</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，使得训练超过</span> 1000 <span style="font-family: 等线">层的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Transformer </span><span style="font-family: 等线">成为可能。</span></p>
<p>DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">通常与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">LayerNorm </span><span style="font-family: 等线">结合使用。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">通过理论推导，</span>DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">认为模型训练不稳定的根源在于梯度消失或爆炸，</span><span style="font-family: 等线">这与模型参数的初始化以及残差连接中的数值范围有很大关系</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span>DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">的目标是限制模型前向传播和反向传播中数值的剧烈变化。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">它主要包含两个部分：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">理论指导的初始化</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span> <span style="font-family: 等线">对于</span> Transformer <span style="font-family: 等线">的某些权重矩阵（例如 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">FFN </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的第二层线性层和注意力机制的输出投影层），使用一个比标准初始化小得多的值进行初始化。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">修改残差连接</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span> <span style="font-family: 等线">在标准的</span> x + Sublayer(x)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">残差连接中，</span>DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">引入一个常数缩放因子 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">α</span><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></li>


</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100105229-87801307.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">数学公式</span>/<span style="font-family: 等线">伪代码</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在一个标准的</span> Transformer <span style="font-family: 等线">块中，残差连接的形式如下：</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Plain Text<br># 标准 Transformer<br>x = x + attention(LayerNorm(x))<br>x = x + ffn(LayerNorm(x))</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">使用</span> DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">后，这个结构会变成：</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Plain Text<br># 使用 DeepNorm 的 Transformer<br>x = LayerNorm(x + \alpha * attention(x)) # 注意，LayerNorm 放在了残差连接之后<br>x = LayerNorm(x + \alpha * ffn(x))</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">其中</span> <span style="font-family: Arial">α </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是一个关键的超参数，它的值由模型的深度 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">N</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（编码器或解码器层数）决定，通常设置为 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">(2N)**</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">1/4</span><span style="font-family: 等线">） 或类似的值，以保证数值范围的稳定。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">同时，</span>FFN <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Attention </span><span style="font-family: 等线">中的某些权重矩阵需要被初始化为一个较小的值，例如用 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">c⋅N**</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">−1/4</span><span style="font-family: 等线">） 这样的因子进行缩放，其中 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">c </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是一个小的常数。</span></p>
<p><strong>DeepNorm <span style="font-family: 等线">的实现不是一个独立的 </span></strong><strong>nn.Module</strong><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，而是对</span> Transformer Block <span style="font-family: 等线">结构的修改。</span></strong></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br><br># 这是一个概念性实现，展示 DeepNorm 如何修改 Transformer 块<br>class DeepNormTransformerBlock(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, dim, num_layers, ffn_expansion_factor=4):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.dim = dim<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_layers = num_layers<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 定义 alpha，这是 DeepNorm 的核心<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.alpha = (2 * self.num_layers) ** 0.25<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(dim, heads=8) # 示例<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.ffn = nn.Sequential(<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nn.Linear(dim, dim * ffn_expansion_factor),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nn.ReLU(),<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nn.Linear(dim * ffn_expansion_factor, dim)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# DeepNorm 特定的初始化<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.init_weights()<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def init_weights(self):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 论文中建议对 FFN 的第二层和 Attention 的输出层进行特殊初始化<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 这里仅为示意，具体初始化策略需参考原论文<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for name, param in self.ffn.named_parameters():<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if 'weight' in name and '1.weight' in name: # 第二个线性层<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nn.init.xavier_normal_(param, gain=0.1) # 示意性的较小初始化<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;for name, param in self.attn.named_parameters():<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if 'out_proj.weight' in name:<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;nn.init.xavier_normal_(param, gain=0.1)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 残差连接的修改<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 注意 LayerNorm 的位置和 alpha 的使用<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_output, _ = self.attn(x, x, x)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x = self.norm1(x + self.alpha * attn_output)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ffn_output = self.ffn(x)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x = self.norm2(x + self.alpha * ffn_output)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return x</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>3. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">位置编码</span></strong></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100123676-1250160247.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RoPE</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">已成为当前大模型架构的</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">黄金标准</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，因为它在性能和外推能力上取得了最佳的平衡。</span></p>
<p><strong>ALiBi</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是一个非常</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优雅且高效</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">的替代方案，它的简单性和强大的外推能力使其在特定场景下极具吸引力。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">相对位置偏置</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是一个经典且有效的方法，但其</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">外推能力弱</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">的缺点使其在需要处理超长文本的现代大模型中逐渐被</span> RoPE <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">ALiBi </span><span style="font-family: 等线">取代。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RoPE <span style="font-family: 等线">旋转位置编码</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">通过绝对位置来编码相对位置关系。</span></strong>&nbsp;RoPE <span style="font-family: 等线">的精妙之处在于，它将位置信息融入到注意力计算中的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query (</span><span style="font-family: 等线">查询</span><span style="font-family: Arial">) </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key (</span><span style="font-family: 等线">键</span><span style="font-family: Arial">) </span><span style="font-family: 等线">向量中。它通过对 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Q </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">K </span><span style="font-family: 等线">向量进行</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">旋转</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">操作，使得</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">两个</span> token <span style="font-family: 等线">的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Q </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">K </span><span style="font-family: 等线">经过旋转后的内积（即注意力分数），只与它们的相对位置有关，而与它们的绝对位置无关。</span></strong></p>
<p>1. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">工作原理</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">想象一个二维平面上的向量</span> v = (x, y)<span style="font-family: 等线">。如果将它旋转</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">θ</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">角度，会得到一个新的向量。</span>RoPE <span style="font-family: 等线">将高维的词向量两两配对，看作是一系列的二维向量（或者说，复数），然后根据其绝对位置 </span>m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">旋转一个特定的角度</span> mθ<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">位置为</span> m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的</span> token <span style="font-family: 等线">的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query </span><span style="font-family: 等线">向量 </span>q_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">会被旋转</span> mθ<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">位置为</span> n&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的</span> token <span style="font-family: 等线">的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key </span><span style="font-family: 等线">向量 </span>k_n&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">会被旋转</span> nθ<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">当计算它们的注意力分数时，即计算</span> (R_m * q_m)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> (R_n * k_n)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的点积，数学上可以</span><span style="font-family: 等线">证明这个结果等于原始向量</span> q_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> k_n&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">与一个</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">只依赖于相对位置</span></strong>&nbsp;(m-n)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的旋转矩阵</span> R_{m-n}&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的运算结果。</span><span style="font-family: 等线">这样，模型就自然地捕捉到了相对位置信息。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">原理解释</span> <span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">假设</span> q_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> k_n&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是位置</span> m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> n&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的向量。</span>RoPE <span style="font-family: 等线">将它们乘以一个旋转矩阵 </span>R<span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100138611-1399682749.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">其中旋转矩阵</span> R_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">定义为：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100143904-124590975.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">这里的</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Consolas">θ_i = 10000^{-2i/d}</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是预设的、不同维度上的旋转</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">角速度</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，</span>d&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是向量维度。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">关键在于，内积（注意力分数）变为：</span> </p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100150724-5861809.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">这个</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">结果只依赖于相对距离</span> </strong><strong>n-m</strong><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></strong></p>
<p>2. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">更详细的原理流程解释</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">第一步</span> <span style="font-family: 等线">计算基础角速度</span> </strong><strong><span style="font-family: Consolas">θ_i</span></strong></p>
<p>RoPE <span style="font-family: 等线">的设计者不希望所有维度都以相同的速度旋转。他们希望：</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">低频部分</span> (low-frequency)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对应向量的前几个维度，旋转得</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">慢</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">（波长长），用于捕捉长距离的相对位置关系。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">高频部分</span> (high-frequency)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对应向量的后几个维度，旋转得</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">快</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">（波长短），用于捕捉短距离、精细的相对位置关系。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">为了实现这一点，他们使用了一个</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">几何级数</span> (geometric progression)</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">来生成这些角速度。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">对于一个维度为</span> d&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的向量，我们有</span> d/2&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">个角速度</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">θ_i</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，其中</span> i&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">从</span> 0&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">到</span> d/2 - 1<span style="font-family: 等线">。公式如下：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100201775-66050949.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<ul>
<li>i<span style="font-family: 等线">：维度对的索引，</span>i ∈ [0, 1, 2, ..., (d/2 - 1)]<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></li>
<li>b<span style="font-family: 等线">：一个预设的基数</span> (base)<span style="font-family: 等线">，通常是一个很大的数，比如 </span><strong>10000</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。这个基数</span> b&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">控制了旋转波长的范围。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">第二步：结合绝对位置</span> </strong><strong>m</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">现在我们有了基础速度</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">θ_i</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，对于一个在序列中绝对位置为</span> m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的</span> token<span style="font-family: 等线">，其在第 </span>i&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">个二维平面上的最终旋转角度就是：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100217158-1588586988.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">这就像物理学中的</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">角位移</span> = 角速度 × 时间<span style="font-family: 等线">。这里，</span>m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">扮演了</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">时间</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">的角色。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">第三步：构建旋转矩阵</span> </strong><strong>R_m</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">有了每个维度对在特定位置</span> m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的最终旋转角度</span> mθ_i<span style="font-family: 等线">，我们就可以构建完整的旋转矩阵</span> R_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">了。</span></p>
<p>R_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是一个</span> d x d&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">块对角矩阵</span> (block-diagonal matrix)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。这意味着它的大部分元素都是</span> 0<span style="font-family: 等线">，只有对角线上一系列 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">2x2 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的小矩阵（块）有值。每个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">2x2 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的块负责旋转一对维度。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">对于第</span> i&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">个维度对（即向量的第</span> 2i&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> 2i+1&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">维），其对应的</span> 2x2 <span style="font-family: 等线">旋转矩阵是标准的二维旋转矩阵：</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100224882-55144617.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">最终，将这个矩阵</span> R_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">应用于原始的</span> Query <span style="font-family: 等线">向量 </span>q_m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">或</span> Key <span style="font-family: 等线">向量 </span>k_m<span style="font-family: 等线">，就完成了位置信息的注入：</span></p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100229062-507418201.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">旋转矩阵</span></strong><strong>R_m</strong><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">实际上是一个巨大的稀疏矩阵，在代码实现中，直接构建并乘以一个巨大的稀疏矩阵</span> </strong><strong>R_m</strong><strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是非常低效的。一个更聪明的方法是利用复数。</span></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">将</span> d&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">维向量</span> x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的每对</span> &nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">看作一个复数</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">在复平面中，旋转一个角度</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">α</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">等价于乘以</span> </li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">所以，旋转操作就变成了简单的</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">复数乘法</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></li>


</ol>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100237160-792268672.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span> PyTorch <span style="font-family: 等线">实现代码中，你会看到</span>torch.view_as_complex&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> torch.polar<span style="font-family: 等线">这些函数，它们将向量转换为复数，进行乘法运算，再转换回实数，从而高效地实现了旋转操作。</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br><br>def precompute_freqs_cis(dim: int, end: int, theta: float = 10000.0):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"""预计算旋转角度的复数表示"""<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算频率 a = 1 / (theta^(2k/d))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;freqs = 1.0 / (theta ** (torch.arange(0, dim, 2)[: (dim // 2)].float() / dim))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算位置 t = [0, 1, ..., end-1]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;t = torch.arange(end, device=freqs.device) #<span style="font-family: Consolas">确保生成的位置张量</span> t&nbsp;<span style="font-family: Consolas">与之前预计算的「角速度张量</span> freqs<span style="font-family: Consolas">」在同一计算设备（如</span> CPU、GPU）上。<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算 t * a 的外积，得到每个位置在每个频率上的角度<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;freqs = torch.outer(t, freqs).float()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 转换为复数形式 cos(theta) + i*sin(theta)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;freqs_cis = torch.polar(torch.ones_like(freqs), freqs)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return freqs_cis<br><br>def apply_rotary_emb(x: torch.Tensor, freqs_cis: torch.Tensor):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"""将旋转位置编码应用到输入张量 x (q 或 k)"""<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 将 x 的最后一维转换为复数 (d -&gt; d/2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# x.shape: [bs, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# x_complex.shape: [bs, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim/2]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 1. x.float().reshape(*x.shape[:-1], -1, 2)的形状是[bs, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim/2，2]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 2. 然后torch.view_as_complex 会将最后一个维度的内容组装成实部虚部，最后一的维度会消失<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x_complex = torch.view_as_complex(x.float().reshape(*x.shape[:-1], -1, 2))<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# freqs_cis 需要调整形状以匹配 x_complex<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# freqs_cis.shape: [seq_len, head_dim/2] -&gt; [1, seq_len, 1, head_dim/2]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;freqs_cis = freqs_cis.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 核心操作：复数乘法实现旋转<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# x_rotated.shape: [bs, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim/2]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#x_complex [bs, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim/2]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#freqs_cis [1 , seq_len, 1 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;, head_dim/2]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x_rotated = x_complex * freqs_cis<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 将旋转后的复数转换回实数张量<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# x_out.shape: [bs, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x_out = torch.view_as_real(x_rotated).flatten(3)#按照第三个维度展平，就是把最后两个合并。<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return x_out.type_as(x)<br><br># 使用示例<br># seq_len, batch_size, num_heads, head_dim = 10, 2, 4, 32<br># freqs_cis = precompute_freqs_cis(head_dim, seq_len)<br># q = torch.randn(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)<br># q_rotated = apply_rotary_emb(q, freqs_cis)<br># print(q_rotated.shape) # torch.Size([2, 10, 4, 32])</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>ALiBi <span style="font-family: 等线">线性偏置注意力</span></strong></p>
<p>ALiBi <span style="font-family: 等线">是一个非常简洁且高效的方案，主要被 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">BLOOM </span><span style="font-family: 等线">模型采用。它的核心思想是，位置信息不应该作用于词向量本身，</span><span style="font-family: 等线">而应该在计算注意力分数时作为一个</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">惩罚项</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">或</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">偏置</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">加入</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">距离惩罚。</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">两个</span> token <span style="font-family: 等线">在序列中的距离越远，它们之间的注意力分数就应该受到越大的惩罚。这个惩罚是线性的，并且是加在 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">softmax </span><span style="font-family: 等线">操作之前。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">工作原理</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在计算完</span> QK^T&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">得到原始的注意力分数矩阵后，</span>ALiBi <span style="font-family: 等线">会加上一个预先计算好的偏置矩阵。</span><span style="font-family: 等线">这个偏置矩阵的值只与</span> query <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">key </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">相对位置有关</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">对于第</span> i&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">个</span> query <span style="font-family: 等线">和第 </span>j&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">个</span> key<span style="font-family: 等线">，添加的偏置是 </span>m * |i - j|<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></li>
<li>|i - j|&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是它们之间的距离。</span></li>
<li>m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是一个为每个注意力头预设的、固定的、不可学习的斜率（</span>slope<span style="font-family: 等线">）。通常，头的编号越小，斜率越大（惩罚越强），编号越大，斜率越小（惩罚越弱）（</span>m&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的值越大，</span>m * (-|i - j|)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的值就越接近</span> 0<span style="font-family: 等线">（即惩罚越弱）），这</span><span style="font-family: 等线">让不同的头关注不同距离范围的信息</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">数学公式</span></strong></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100248191-1644215343.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">在解码器中，为了保证因果性，通常会结合上三角掩码。</span> </p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100253139-432845819.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">其中</span> BiasMatrix[i, j] = m * |i - j|&nbsp;(<span style="font-family: 等线">对于 </span>j &lt;= i)<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import math<br><br>def get_alibi_biases(num_heads, seq_len):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"""计算 ALiBi 偏置矩阵"""<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算每个头的斜率 m<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def get_slopes(n):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算最接近 2^-(8/n) 的 2 的幂<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def get_next_power_of_2(x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return 2 ** math.floor(math.log2(x))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;start = (2**(-2**-(math.log2(n)-3)))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ratio = start<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return [start*ratio**i for i in range(n)]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;slopes = torch.Tensor(get_slopes(num_heads))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 计算距离矩阵 |i - j|<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 注意：这里是解码器场景，所以是下三角矩阵<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# &nbsp;unsqueeze(1) “第 1 个维度位置” 插入一个新的、尺寸为 1 的维度<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 变成了 shape： 【sep_len，1】 &nbsp;&nbsp;和 &nbsp;&nbsp;【1，sep_len】<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;alibi = torch.arange(seq_len).unsqueeze(1) - torch.arange(seq_len).unsqueeze(0)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;#现在我们用形状为 (5, 1) 的列向量减去形状为 (1, 5) 的行向量。PyTorch 的广播机制会自动将它们扩展到相同的形状 (5, 5) 再进行逐元素相减。<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;alibi = -torch.abs(alibi) # 变成负数<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 每个头的斜率乘以距离矩阵<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 【1，sep_len，sep_len】 &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;[num_heads，1,1]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;alibi = alibi.unsqueeze(0) * slopes.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)# 【num_heads，sep_len，1，sep_len】<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return alibi<br><br># 使用示例<br># num_heads, seq_len = 4, 10<br># attn_scores = torch.randn(1, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len) # 假设这是 QK^T<br># alibi_biases = get_alibi_biases(num_heads, seq_len)<br>#<br># # 添加偏置<br># attn_scores_with_alibi = attn_scores + alibi_biases<br># print(attn_scores_with_alibi.shape) # torch.Size([1, 4, 10, 10])</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">相对位置偏置</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">这是</span> T5<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">DeBERTa </span><span style="font-family: 等线">等模型中使用的经典方法。它的思想与 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">ALiBi </span><span style="font-family: 等线">类似，都是在注意力分数上添加偏置，但这个偏置是</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">可学习的</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">为不同的相对距离学习一个专属的偏置值。</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">模型会维护一个查询表（</span>Embedding Table<span style="font-family: 等线">），</span><span style="font-family: 等线">根据两个</span> token <span style="font-family: 等线">的相对距离 </span>i - j<span style="font-family: 等线">，从表中查找对应的偏置值，加到注意力分数上。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">工作原理</span></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">计算相对距离</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对于注意力矩阵中的每个元素</span> (i, j)<span style="font-family: 等线">，计算其相对距离</span> i - j<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">分桶</span> (Bucketing)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：由于相对距离的范围可能很大，</span><span style="font-family: 等线">直接为每个距离都学习一个偏置不现实</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。因此，通常会使用</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">分桶</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">策略，将一定范围内的距离映射到同一个桶里（例如，距离 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">8-15 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">都属于一个桶）。这样可以大大减少需要学习的参数量。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">查找偏置</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：创建一个可学习的</span> Embedding <span style="font-family: 等线">层，其大小为桶的数量。根据分桶后的相对距离索引，从这个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Embedding </span><span style="font-family: 等线">层中查找对应的偏置向量。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">添加偏置</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：将查找到的偏置值加到</span> QK^T&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">的对应位置上。</span></li>


</ol>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">数学公式</span></strong></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100305801-1074636870.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">其中</span> b_ij&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是从一个可学习的查询表</span> B&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中根据相对位置</span> i - j&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">查找得到的值：</span> </p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100309515-587112392.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p><br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br><br>class RelativePositionBias(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, num_buckets, max_distance, num_heads):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_buckets = num_buckets<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.max_distance = max_distance<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_heads = num_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 创建可学习的偏置查询表<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.relative_attention_bias = nn.Embedding(self.num_buckets, self.num_heads)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def _relative_position_bucket(self, relative_position):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;"""将相对距离分桶"""<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 正负距离分开处理<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;num_buckets = self.num_buckets // 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ret = (relative_position &gt; 0).to(torch.long) * num_buckets<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;n = torch.abs(relative_position)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 超过 max_distance 的距离被归入同一个桶<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;max_exact = num_buckets // 2<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;is_small = n &lt; max_exact<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 对近距离使用对数分桶，远距离直接映射<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;val_if_large = max_exact + (<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;torch.log(n.float() / max_exact) / math.log(self.max_distance / max_exact) * (num_buckets - max_exact)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;).to(torch.long)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;val_if_large = torch.min(val_if_large, torch.full_like(val_if_large, num_buckets - 1))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;ret += torch.where(is_small, n, val_if_large)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return ret<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, seq_len):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;q_pos = torch.arange(seq_len, dtype=torch.long)[:, None]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;k_pos = torch.arange(seq_len, dtype=torch.long)[None, :]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;relative_position = k_pos - q_pos # 计算相对距离矩阵<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bucketed_position = self._relative_position_bucket(relative_position)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 从 Embedding 表中查找偏置<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bias = self.relative_attention_bias(bucketed_position) # [seq_len, seq_len, num_heads]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 调整形状以匹配注意力分数矩阵 [1, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;bias = bias.permute(2, 0, 1).unsqueeze(0)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return bias<br><br># 使用示例<br># num_heads, seq_len = 4, 10<br># attn_scores = torch.randn(1, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len)<br># relative_bias_module = RelativePositionBias(num_buckets=32, max_distance=128, num_heads=num_heads)<br># biases = relative_bias_module(seq_len)<br>#<br># attn_scores_with_bias = attn_scores + biases<br># print(attn_scores_with_bias.shape) # torch.Size([1, 4, 10, 10])</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">激活函数</span></strong></p>
<p><strong>GELU</strong>: <strong>BLOOM<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Falcon</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">T5</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">等模型使用，是</span> BERT <span style="font-family: 等线">时代以来的常用选择。</span></p>
<p><strong>SwiGLU</strong>: <span style="font-family: 等线">一种门控线性单元，</span><strong>LLaMA<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Mixtral</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Qwen</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">DeepSeek</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">ChatGLM</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">等新一代模型的选择。实践证明，</span>SwiGLU <span style="font-family: 等线">能带来比 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">GELU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">ReLU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">更好的性能。</span></p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100320243-705182889.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>GELU</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">设计思想是结合随机正则化（如</span> Dropout<span style="font-family: 等线">）和传统激活函数（如 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">ReLU</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）的优点。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">随机的、平滑的</span> ReLU<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></strong>&nbsp;ReLU <span style="font-family: 等线">的</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">门控</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">是确定性的：如果输入 </span>x &gt; 0<span style="font-family: 等线">，门就打开（输出</span> x<span style="font-family: 等线">）；如果</span> x &lt;= 0<span style="font-family: 等线">，门就关闭（输出</span> 0<span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></p>
<p>GELU <span style="font-family: 等线">的门控则是</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">概率性</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">的。它根据输入值</span> x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">服从标准正态分布的概率来决定其输出。具体来说，它将输入</span> x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">乘以一个范围在</span> (0, 1) <span style="font-family: 等线">之间的</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">门控值</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，这个门控值由高斯累积分布函数 </span><span style="font-family: Consolas">Φ(x)</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">决定。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">如果一个输入</span> x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">非常小（远小于其他输入），那么</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">Φ(x)</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">会接近</span> 0<span style="font-family: 等线">，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GELU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的输出也接近 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">0</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（门关闭）。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">如果一个输入</span> x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">非常大（远大于其他输入），那么</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">Φ(x)</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">会接近</span> 1<span style="font-family: 等线">，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GELU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的输出就接近 </span>x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">本身（门打开）。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">对于接近</span> 0 <span style="font-family: 等线">的输入，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GELU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">提供了一个非常平滑的过渡，而不是像 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">ReLU </span><span style="font-family: 等线">那样在 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">0 </span><span style="font-family: 等线">点有一个突变。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">数学公式</span></strong></p>
<p>GELU <span style="font-family: 等线">的精确定义是： </span></p>
<p align="center">GELU(x)=x⋅Φ(x)</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">其中</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">Φ(x)</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是标准正态分布的累积分布函数</span> (CDF)<span style="font-family: 等线">。由于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">CDF </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的计算比较复杂，实践中通常使用一个更快的近似公式：</span></p>
<p align="center">GELU(x)≈x⋅σ(1.702⋅x)</p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">其中</span> <span style="font-family: Consolas">σ</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是</span> Sigmoid <span style="font-family: 等线">函数。这个近似版本在性能上几乎没有差异，但计算速度更快。</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br>import torch.nn.functional as F<br>import math<br><br># 使用 PyTorch 内置的 GELU<br>gelu_builtin = nn.GELU()<br>x = torch.randn(5)<br>print(f"Input: {x}")<br>print(f"Built-in GELU output: {gelu_builtin(x)}")<br><br># 手动实现精确的 GELU (使用误差函数 erf)<br>def gelu_exact(x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# Φ(x) = 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return x * 0.5 * (1.0 + torch.erf(x / math.sqrt(2.0)))<br><br>print(f"Manual exact GELU: &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;{gelu_exact(x)}")<br><br># 手动实现近似的 GELU<br>def gelu_approx(x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return x * torch.sigmoid(1.702 * x)<br><br>print(f"Manual approx GELU: &nbsp;&nbsp;{gelu_approx(x)}")</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>SwiGLU</strong></p>
<p>SwiGLU <span style="font-family: 等线">不仅仅是一个激活函数，它是一种</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">激活结构</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。它属于</span><span style="font-family: 等线">门控线性单元</span>&nbsp;(Gated Linear Unit, GLU) <span style="font-family: 等线">家族。它的出现，显著提升了 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Transformer </span><span style="font-family: 等线">模型中前馈网络 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">(FFN) </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的性能。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">显式的门控机制。</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">与</span> GELU <span style="font-family: 等线">的隐式概率门控不同，</span>SwiGLU <span style="font-family: 等线">设计了一个非常直接的</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">门</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。你可以把它想象成一个</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">音量旋钮</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在前馈网络中，输入</span> x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">会被送到</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">两个</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">并行的线性层，产生两个输出</span> A&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> B<span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">内容向量</span> (Content Vector)</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>A</strong>: <span style="font-family: 等线">这是主要的、携带信息的数据流。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">门控向量</span> (Gate Vector) </strong><strong>B</strong>: <span style="font-family: 等线">这个向量经过</span> Swish/SiLU <span style="font-family: 等线">激活函数后</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，将决定内容向量</span> A&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中有多少信息可以通过。</span></li>


</ol>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">最后，将</span> A&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> Swish(B)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">进行</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">元素级相乘</span> </strong><strong>(element-wise multiplication)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。如果</span> Swish(B)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中某个元素接近</span> 0<span style="font-family: 等线">，那么 </span>A&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中对应位置的信息就会被</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">静音</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">；如果 </span>Swish(B)&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中某个元素值较大，</span>A&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">中对应的信息就会被放大或通过。</span></p>
<p><strong>Swish (<span style="font-family: 等线">或 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">SiLU)</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">本身也是一个激活函数，其公式是</span> x * sigmoid(x)<span style="font-family: 等线">。它被选为门控函数是因为它平滑、非单调，并且在实践中表现出色。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">数学公式</span></strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">一个标准的</span> SwiGLU <span style="font-family: 等线">前馈网络层通常由三个线性层组成：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">上投影</span>/<span style="font-family: 等线">门投影层 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">(</span>gate_proj&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">和</span> up_proj): <span style="font-family: 等线">将输入 </span>x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">投影到更高的中间维度。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">下投影层</span> (down_proj): <span style="font-family: 等线">将结果投影回原始维度。</span></li>


</ol>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100333606-306296181.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">其中：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>x&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">是输入。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">是三个线性层的权重矩阵。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">是</span>sigmod<span style="font-family: 等线">函数</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: Consolas">⊙</span>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">代表元素级相乘。</span></li>


</ul>
<p>https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/31289994147</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br>import torch.nn.functional as F<br><br>class SwiGLU_FFN(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_features, out_features):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 通常 hidden_features 会被设置为 in_features 的倍数，<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 例如 4 * in_features。为了保持参数量与标准 FFN 相似，<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# LLaMA 等模型会使用 2/3 * (4 * in_features) 的技巧。<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 这里为了清晰，我们直接使用 hidden_features。<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.gate_proj = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features, bias=False)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.up_proj = nn.Linear(in_features, hidden_features, bias=False)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.down_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_features, out_features, bias=False)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, x):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# x.shape: [batch_size, seq_len, in_features]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 门控向量<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;gate = self.gate_proj(x)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# gate.shape: [batch_size, seq_len, hidden_features]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 内容向量<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;up = self.up_proj(x)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# up.shape: [batch_size, seq_len, hidden_features]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 核心操作：应用 SiLU (Swish) 到门控上，然后与内容相乘<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;fused_gate_up = F.silu(gate) * up<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# fused_gate_up.shape: [batch_size, seq_len, hidden_features]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 投影回原始维度<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = self.down_proj(fused_gate_up)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# output.shape: [batch_size, seq_len, out_features]<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return output<br><br># 使用示例<br>in_dim = 64<br>hidden_dim = 128<br>out_dim = 64<br>swiglu_ffn = SwiGLU_FFN(in_dim, hidden_dim, out_dim)<br>x = torch.randn(4, 10, in_dim) # [batch, seq_len, features]<br>output = swiglu_ffn(x)<br>print(f"Input shape: {x.shape}")<br>print(f"SwiGLU FFN output shape: {output.shape}")</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">为什么</span>LLaMA<span style="font-family: 等线">等大模型选择</span><span style="font-family: Arial">SwiGLU</span><span style="font-family: 等线">而非</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GELU</span><span style="font-family: 等线">？</span></li>


</ul>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">核心原因：</span>SwiGLU<span style="font-family: 等线">在相同参数量下表现更优的实验结果（如下游任务准确率提升</span><span style="font-family: Arial">0.6%</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）；门控机制减少了</span><span style="font-family: Arial">FFN</span><span style="font-family: 等线">层的冗余计算，适合长序列处理。</span></p>
<ul>
<li>SwiGLU<span style="font-family: 等线">在低资源训练场景下的优化策略</span></li>


</ul>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">策略建议：采用</span>LoRA<span style="font-family: 等线">微调（冻结大部分参数，仅训练门控相关矩阵）；使用混合精度训练（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">FP16</span><span style="font-family: 等线">存储</span><span style="font-family: Arial">+FP32</span><span style="font-family: 等线">计算门控乘积）。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>5. <strong><span style="font-family: 等线">注意力机制</span></strong></p>
