<p><strong>MHA (Multi-Head Attention)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：标准多头注意力，</span><strong>BLOOM<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">T5</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">等早期模型使用。每个头都有独立的查询</span>(Q)<span style="font-family: 等线">、键</span><span style="font-family: Arial">(K)</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、值</span><span style="font-family: Arial">(V)</span><span style="font-family: 等线">矩阵，表达能力最强，但计算和显存开销最大。</span></p>
<p><strong>GQA (Grouped-Query Attention)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：分组查询注意力，被</span> <strong>LLaMA 2/3<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Mixtral</span><span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Qwen</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">等新一代模型广泛采用。它将查询头分组，组内共享一套</span> K <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">V</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。这是在性能和效率之间取得的绝佳平衡。</span></p>
<p><strong>MQA (Multi-Query Attention)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：多查询注意力，</span><strong>Falcon</strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">采用。这是</span> GQA <span style="font-family: 等线">的一个极端形式，所有查询头共享同一套 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">K </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">V</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。推理速度极快，但可能带来轻微的性能损失。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在现代大语言模型（</span>LLM<span style="font-family: 等线">）的设计中，</span><strong>GQA <span style="font-family: 等线">已经成为事实上的标准</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，因为它能够在几乎不损失模型性能的前提下，获得与</span> MQA <span style="font-family: 等线">相近的推理速度和内存优势，是目前最佳的权衡方案。</span></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100346180-1977987325.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>MHA <span style="font-family: 等线">多头注意力机制</span></strong></p>
<p>MHA <span style="font-family: 等线">是原始 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Transformer </span><span style="font-family: 等线">论文《</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Attention Is All You Need</span><span style="font-family: 等线">》中提出的标准注意力机制。它是后续所有变体的基础。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p>MHA <span style="font-family: 等线">的核心思想是</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">分而治之</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。它没有让模型只进行一次单一的、高维度的注意力计算，而是将模型的维度（</span>d_model<span style="font-family: 等线">）拆分成多个</span><span style="font-family: Arial">“</span><span style="font-family: 等线">头</span><span style="font-family: Arial">”</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">heads</span><span style="font-family: 等线">），每个头在较低的维度上并行地进行注意力计算。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">这允许模型在不同的表示子空间中同时关注来自不同位置的信息。例如，一个头可能关注句法关系，另一个头可能关注语义上的近义词。最后，将所有头的输出拼接起来，通过一个线性层进行融合。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">结构与公式</span></strong></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">输入</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：查询（</span>Query, Q<span style="font-family: 等线">）、键（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key, K</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）、值（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value, V</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></li>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">线性投影</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：将</span> Q, K, V <span style="font-family: 等线">分别通过 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个独立的线性层，投影成 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">组低维的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Qi,Ki,Vi</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">是头的数量。</span></li>


</ol>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100354976-19728198.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">并行计算注意力</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：对每一个头，独立计算缩放点积注意力（</span>Scaled Dot-Product Attention<span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></li>


</ol>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100359204-429238869.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">其中</span> dk <span style="font-family: 等线">是每个头的维度（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">dk = d_model / h</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></p>
<ol>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">拼接与融合</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：将所有头的输出拼接起来，再通过一个最终的线性层</span> WO <span style="font-family: 等线">进行融合。</span></li>


</ol>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2780283/202512/2780283-20251225100404605-482811609.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center">&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">关键点</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：每个头都有一套独立的</span> Q, K, V <span style="font-family: 等线">权重矩阵。如果有 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个头，就有 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">组 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Q </span><span style="font-family: 等线">投影矩阵、 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">组 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">K </span><span style="font-family: 等线">投影矩阵和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">h </span><span style="font-family: 等线">组 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">V </span><span style="font-family: 等线">投影矩阵。</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>import torch<br>import torch.nn as nn<br>import math<br><br>class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, d_model, num_heads):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;assert d_model % num_heads == 0, "d_model must be divisible by num_heads"<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.d_model = d_model<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_heads = num_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.d_k = d_model // num_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# MHA: 每个头都有自己的 Q, K, V 投影权重<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 这里用一个大的线性层实现，然后分割，效率更高<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wq = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wk = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wv = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wo = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, q, k, v, mask=None):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;batch_size, seq_len, _ = q.shape<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 1. 线性投影<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, seq_len, d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;q = self.wq(q)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;k = self.wk(k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v = self.wv(v)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 2. 拆分成多个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, d_k) -&gt; (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;q = q.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# view是维度重塑，transpose 是维度交换<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# view是维度重塑， reshape实际上是，调用contiguous()让张量变为连续内存存储，然后调用view<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;k = k.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v = v.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 3. 计算注意力分数<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k) @ (batch_size, num_heads, d_k, seq_len) -&gt; (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_scores = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(self.d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# @ 是矩阵乘法<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if mask is not None:<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_scores = attn_scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 4. 应用注意力权重到 V<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len) @ (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k) -&gt; (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = attn_weights @ v<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 5. 拼接头并进行最终线性变换<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k) -&gt; (batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, d_k) -&gt; (batch_size, seq_len, d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, seq_len, self.d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return self.wo(output)</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>MQA <span style="font-family: 等线">多查询注意力机制</span></strong></p>
<p>MQA <span style="font-family: 等线">是对 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的一种简化，旨在解决 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">在推理时的一个巨大瓶颈：</span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV </span><span style="font-family: 等线">缓存（</span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV Cache</span><span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在自回归生成（</span>autoregressive decoding<span style="font-family: 等线">）任务中，模型每生成一个新 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，都需要将这个新 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value </span><span style="font-family: 等线">与之前所有 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">token </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value </span><span style="font-family: 等线">拼接起来。对于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA</span><span style="font-family: 等线">，你需要为 </span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">每个头</span></strong>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">都存储和加载一套</span> K <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">V</span><span style="font-family: 等线">。这导致了巨大的内存带宽消耗。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p>MQA <span style="font-family: 等线">提出，多个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头可以 </span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">共享同一组</span> Key <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value </span><span style="font-family: 等线">投影</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Query (Q)</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：仍然有</span> h <span style="font-family: 等线">个独立的头，和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">一样。</span></li>
<li><strong>Key (K) <span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value (V)</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：不再有</span> h <span style="font-family: 等线">个头，而是 </span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">只有</span> 1 <span style="font-family: 等线">个头</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">，这个头被所有的</span> Query <span style="font-family: 等线">头共享。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优势与劣势</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优势</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></li>


</ul>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">大幅减少</span> KV <span style="font-family: 等线">缓存大小</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>KV <span style="font-family: 等线">缓存的大小从 </span>[batch, num_heads, seq_len, d_k]&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">变为</span> [batch, 1, seq_len, d_k]<span style="font-family: 等线">，减少为原来的</span> 1/h<span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">显著提升推理速度</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：内存带宽是</span> LLM <span style="font-family: 等线">推理的主要瓶颈，减少 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV </span><span style="font-family: 等线">缓存的读写量可以极大地加速生成过程。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">劣势</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></li>


</ul>
<p>￮&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-family: 等线">可能导致模型质量下降</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：所有</span> Query <span style="font-family: 等线">头被迫从同一组 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">K </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">V </span><span style="font-family: 等线">中提取信息，模型的表达能力受到限制，可能会牺牲一些性能。</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>class MultiQueryAttention(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, d_model, num_heads):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;assert d_model % num_heads == 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.d_model = d_model<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_heads = num_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.d_k = d_model // num_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wq = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model) # Q 仍然有 num_heads 个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# MQA: K 和 V 共享一个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wk = nn.Linear(d_model, self.d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wv = nn.Linear(d_model, self.d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wo = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, q, k, v, mask=None):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;batch_size, seq_len, _ = q.shape<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 投影 Q，并拆分成多个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;q = self.wq(q)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;q = q.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 投影 K 和 V，它们只有一个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, seq_len, d_k) -&gt; (batch_size, 1, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;k = self.wk(k).view(batch_size, seq_len, 1, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v = self.wv(v).view(batch_size, seq_len, 1, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# K 和 V 的头维度是 1，在计算注意力时会自动广播 (broadcast) 到 num_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k) @ (batch_size, 1, d_k, seq_len) -&gt; (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_scores = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(self.d_k)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if mask is not None:<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_scores = attn_scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len) @ (batch_size, 1, seq_len, d_k) -&gt; (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = attn_weights @ v<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, seq_len, self.d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return self.wo(output)</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>GQA<span style="font-family: 等线">分组查询注意力</span></strong></p>
<p>GQA <span style="font-family: 等线">是 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MQA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">之间的一个折衷方案，旨在 </span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">同时获得</span> MQA <span style="font-family: 等线">的高效率和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的高质量</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。它被用于</span> Llama 2<span style="font-family: 等线">、</span><span style="font-family: Arial">Mistral </span><span style="font-family: 等线">等先进模型中。</span></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">核心思想</span></strong></p>
<p>GQA <span style="font-family: 等线">将 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头分成 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">g </span><span style="font-family: 等线">个组，</span><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">每个组内的所有</span> Query <span style="font-family: 等线">头共享同一组 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key </span><span style="font-family: 等线">和 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Value </span><span style="font-family: 等线">投影</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">假设有</span> h <span style="font-family: 等线">个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">假设有</span> g <span style="font-family: 等线">个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Key/Value </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头（也叫 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头）。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">要求</span> h <span style="font-family: 等线">必须是 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">g </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的整数倍。</span></li>
<li>h/g <span style="font-family: 等线">个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Query </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头会共享同一套 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV </span><span style="font-family: 等线">投影。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">两个极端情况</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">当</span> g=h <span style="font-family: 等线">时，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GQA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">等价于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（每个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Q </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头都有自己的 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头）。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 等线">当</span> g=1 <span style="font-family: 等线">时，</span><span style="font-family: Arial">GQA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">等价于 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MQA</span><span style="font-family: 等线">（所有 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">Q </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头共享一个 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">KV </span><span style="font-family: 等线">头）。</span></li>


</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优势与劣势</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">优势</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></li>


</ul>
<p>￮&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">在模型质量上，远超</span> MQA<span style="font-family: 等线">，非常接近 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MHA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的水平。</span></p>
<p>￮&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">在推理速度和内存占用上，远优于</span> MHA<span style="font-family: 等线">，接近 </span><span style="font-family: Arial">MQA </span><span style="font-family: 等线">的水平。</span></p>
<p>￮&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">提供了一个可以在性能和效率之间灵活权衡的旋钮（参数</span> g<span style="font-family: 等线">）。</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">劣势</span></strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span></li>


</ul>
<p>￮&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">实现比</span> MQA <span style="font-family: 等线">稍微复杂一点。</span></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td valign="top" width="690">
<p>Python<br>class GroupedQueryAttention(nn.Module):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def __init__(self, d_model, num_q_heads, num_kv_heads):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;super().__init__()<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;assert d_model % num_q_heads == 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;assert num_q_heads % num_kv_heads == 0<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.d_model = d_model<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_q_heads = num_q_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_kv_heads = num_kv_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.num_groups = num_q_heads // num_kv_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.d_k = d_model // num_q_heads<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wq = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# GQA: 有 num_kv_heads 组 K, V<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wk = nn.Linear(d_model, self.num_kv_heads * self.d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wv = nn.Linear(d_model, self.num_kv_heads * self.d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;self.wo = nn.Linear(d_model, d_model)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def repeat_kv(self, x, num_reps):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# x: (batch_size, num_kv_heads, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# -&gt; (batch_size, num_kv_heads, 1, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# -&gt; (batch_size, num_kv_heads, num_reps, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# -&gt; (batch_size, num_q_heads, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;batch_size, _, seq_len, d_k = x.shape<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;x = x.unsqueeze(2).expand(batch_size, self.num_kv_heads,&nbsp;<strong>num_reps</strong>, seq_len, d_k)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return x.reshape(batch_size, self.num_q_heads, seq_len, d_k)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;def forward(self, q, k, v, mask=None):<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;batch_size, seq_len, _ = q.shape<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 投影 Q，并拆分成 num_q_heads 个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;q = self.wq(q).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_q_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 投影 K 和 V，拆分成 num_kv_heads 个头<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;k = self.wk(k).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v = self.wv(v).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_kv_heads, self.d_k).transpose(1, 2)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 将 KV 头重复以匹配 Q 头的分组<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;k = self.repeat_kv(k, self.num_groups)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;v = self.repeat_kv(v, self.num_groups)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# (batch_size, num_q_heads, seq_len, d_k) @ (batch_size, num_q_heads, d_k, seq_len) -&gt; (batch_size, num_q_heads, seq_len, seq_len)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_scores = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(self.d_k)<br><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;if mask is not None:<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_scores = attn_scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e9)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;attn_weights = torch.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = attn_weights @ v<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, seq_len, self.d_model)<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;return self.wo(output)</p>


</td>


</tr>


</tbody>


</table>
</div>
